a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 almost certainly leaves us both dead, since a storm will probably hit after round 1 with both units empty. So I plan to take 4 in round 1 instead of following the agreement. I'm telling you now rather than defecting quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end up short. If you'd rather operate, and we survive the storm, I'll operate with you afterward to refill the reserve so you can take 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on, so the reserve refills and you can take 4. You can count on that.
